concepts.title: Converting Fractions to Percentage
concepts.definition: A fractional number is expressed as a rate out of one hundred by scaling the fraction by 100.
concepts.key_idea: Multiplying any fractional value by 100 yields its equivalent percentage representation.
question_patterns: convert fraction to per cent
write as a percentage
what is the percentage of girls out of total children
express the given fraction as a percent

solution_steps.explain: Convert the fractional share into parts per hundred

concepts.title: Converting Decimals to Percentage
concepts.definition: A decimal numeral is converted to a percentage by shifting the decimal point two places to the right, which corresponds to multiplication by 100.
concepts.key_idea: Decimals represent hundredths and tenths; multiplying by 100 gives the percent value directly.
question_patterns: convert decimal to per cent
write decimal as percentage
express decimal fraction as percent
change decimal number to percent

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the given decimal number by 100 to obtain the percentage

concepts.title: Converting Percentage to Fraction or Decimal and Complementary Parts
concepts.definition: Given a percentage value, it can be written as a fraction with denominator 100 or divided to obtain a decimal. All component percentages sum to 100 percent.
concepts.key_idea: A full whole corresponds to 100%, and remaining portions are computed by subtracting known shares from 100.
question_patterns: find the remaining percentage
what percent of students do not have bicycles
if some percent are of one kind what percent are remaining
calculate remaining part percentage

solution_steps.explain: The complete whole is 100 percent, so subtract known components

concepts.title: Finding Quantity from Percentage and Whole Quantity
concepts.definition: To find a portion of a total, evaluate the specified percentage out of that quantity; conversely, find the whole quantity when a percentage portion is known.
concepts.key_idea: Percentage of a quantity is obtained by taking the fraction out of 100 times the total.
question_patterns: find percentage of a given number
how many children liked playing football
find the whole quantity if percent of it is given
calculate value of given percent of quantity

solution_steps.explain: Multiply the total quantity by the percentage fraction

concepts.title: Converting Ratios to Percentage
concepts.definition: When parts of a whole are given as a ratio, each part is expressed as a fraction of the total sum of parts, then converted to a percentage.
concepts.key_idea: Add all ratio terms to get total parts, then multiply each fractional part by 100.
question_patterns: convert each part of ratio to percentage
what percentage of mixture is rice and urad dal
find percentage of each share in ratio
divide money according to ratio and express in percent

solution_steps.explain: Find the total number of parts in the ratio
Convert first ratio term to percentage
Convert second ratio term to percentage

concepts.title: Percentage Increase or Decrease
concepts.definition: The relative change in a quantity is the difference between new and original values divided by the original value, expressed as a percentage.
concepts.key_idea: Percentage change is always calculated with the initial or original value as the base.
question_patterns: find percentage of increase or decrease
what is the percent increase in games won
calculate percentage decrease in population
by what percentage has the price gone up

solution_steps.explain: Calculate the difference between the final and initial quantities
Divide the change by the original value and multiply by 100

concepts.title: Profit and Loss Percentage
concepts.definition: Profit occurs when selling price exceeds cost price; loss occurs when cost price exceeds selling price. Both profit percent and loss percent are computed relative to the cost price.
concepts.key_idea: Profit or loss percentage is always determined on the base of Cost Price (CP).
question_patterns: find profit per cent or loss per cent
calculate gain percentage on selling an item
tell what is profit or loss and its percentage
determine loss percent if item bought and sold

solution_steps.explain: Subtract cost price from selling price
Calculate profit as a percentage of cost price

concepts.title: Finding Selling Price or Cost Price from Profit/Loss Percentage
concepts.definition: Using given cost price and profit or loss percentage, the final selling price can be determined, and vice-versa.
concepts.key_idea: Selling price equals cost price plus profit, or cost price minus loss.
question_patterns: find the price at which it is sold
calculate selling price given cost price and profit percent
what is the cost price if selling price and profit percent are given
find cost price given loss percent and selling price

solution_steps.explain: Find profit by multiplying cost price by profit rate
Add profit to the cost price

concepts.title: Simple Interest and Total Amount
concepts.definition: Simple interest is the fixed extra charge paid for borrowing money over time, calculated uniformly on the original principal sum.
concepts.formula: simple_interest = (principal * rate * time) / 100, amount = principal + simple_interest
concepts.key_idea: Interest accumulates proportionally with principal, annual interest rate, and time in years.
question_patterns: find simple interest and amount
calculate interest to be paid at the end of years
find the amount to be paid at the end of time period
how much interest is earned on a sum

solution_steps.explain: Multiply principal, rate, and time, then divide by 100
Add simple interest to the principal sum

concepts.title: Finding Principal, Rate, or Time in Simple Interest
concepts.definition: When simple interest and any two of principal, rate, and time are given, the remaining unknown variable can be isolated and evaluated.
concepts.key_idea: Re-arranging the simple interest formula allows solving for rate, time, or principal.
question_patterns: find the rate of interest
what rate gives interest on a sum in given years
after how many years would interest be earned
find the sum borrowed if interest is known

solution_steps.explain: Multiply interest by 100 and divide by product of principal and time
